name: multi-digit file descriptors, reading, writing, and closing
combined redirects &> and &>> and noclobber >|
source:
make &> build.log
make test &>> build.log
echo force >| clobber.txt

name: bash automatic fd allocation {var}>file and closing
redirections applied to compound if, while, for, and brace groups
source:
if [ -f a ]; then cat a; else cat b; fi > if_out.txt 2>&1
while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done < in.txt > out.txt
for x in 1 2 3; do echo "$x"; done > for_out.txt
{ date; uptime; } > brace_out.txt
( cd /tmp && ls ) > subshell_out.txt

name: multiple chained heredocs across pipeline
source:
cmd1 <<EOF1 | cmd2 <<EOF2 | cmd3 <<EOF3
first body
EOF1
second body
EOF2
third body
EOF3

name: heredoc supplying input to while read loop
source:
while read -r key val; do
  echo "$key => $val"
done <<'EOF'
name Alice
age 30
city London
EOF

name: heredoc in if condition line continuing with then
source:
if grep -q "pattern" <<EOF; then
line containing pattern
EOF
  echo "matched"
fi
